title: Compaction clears screen - can't scroll up to see previous context
body:
## Problem

When compaction happens, the screen clears and users can't scroll up to see the previous conversation context. This is disorienting - you lose visual continuity of what was just discussed.

## Expected Behavior

Either:
- Preserve scroll history so users can scroll up
- Or show a summary of recent context after compaction

## Impact

This is particularly frustrating when compaction happens mid-task and you need to reference something that was just shown (code snippets, decisions made, etc.).
author: TechNickAI

top_comments.author: lukehutch
top_comments.body:
@kali113 if it's by design, it's a very badly-thought-out design. Are you on the Anthropic team?

Clearing the scrollback on compaction loses very valuable information, and combined with the fact that Claude often forgets what precisely it was doing when the conversation had to be compacted, this is a major usability problem.

top_comments.body: @lukehutch nooo, I don't work for Anthropic, you can Ctrl+o to see what was fed into Claude. I think that it should be a setting, you are getting a 👍🏼.
